title: Pointwise standard tame charts for a generic torsor over a DVR
statement:
Let $A$ be a discrete valuation ring (a nonfield local principal ideal domain), $K$ a field with an $A$-algebra structure making it the fraction field of $A$, and $d:L	o\operatorname{Spec}A$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Write $b:\operatorname{Spec}K	o\operatorname{Spec}A$ for the algebra map, $L_K=L	imes_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}K$ and $j:L_K	o L$ for the first projection [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $G$ be a finite group with $|G|$ invertible in $A$ and $W	o L_K$ a finite etale $G$-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let $p:W	o L$ be its composite with $j$, and let $
u:p.\mathrm{normalization}	o L$ be the concrete relative normalization [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization]. If $
u$ is finite, every $x\in L$ has an affine etale neighbourhood $\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}R	o L$ and $y\in\operatorname{Spec}R$ with $\varphi(y)=x$, and integers $m\geq0$, $e_k>0$ for $k\in\operatorname{Fin}m$, all invertible in $R$, together with $f\in R$, such that $
u	imes_L\operatorname{Spec}R$ is isomorphic over $\operatorname{Spec}R$ to $\operatorname{Spec}\prod_{k\in\operatorname{Fin}m}R[T]/(T^{e_k}-f)$. All schemes and rings lie in one universe; the group lies in the next universe. The case $m=0$ uses the empty product ring.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sbc-trait-generic-root-model] at x. It supplies the affine etale neighborhood, the concrete product root scheme N with normal domain stalks, and a dense open V identified with the generic cover pulled back to this neighborhood. Its statement concerns the generic cover, not its normalization.

Each polynomial X^e_k-C f is monic since e_k>0. Mathlib Polynomial.Monic.finite_adjoinRoot and Module.Finite.pi make the product a finite R-module. IsFinite.SpecMap_iff makes q:N -> Spec R finite and hence integral. The DVR is Noetherian. Successive applications of LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian to the smooth d, etale phi and finite q make L, Spec R and N locally Noetherian; therefore V -> N is quasi-compact. Apply [lem-sbc-normalization-dense-open] to identify the normalization of N in V with N.

The private Lean helper normalization_iso_of_dense_open_model constructs a:g.normalization -> N using normalizationDesc, where g is the pulled-back generic cover and gamma identifies its source with V. The integral a allows the inverse generic map V -> g.normalization to descend from V.ι.normalization; precompose with the inverse of its canonical isomorphism onto N to get c:N -> g.normalization. normalizationDesc_comp gives c;a=id. The equality on V and normalization.hom_ext give a;c=id; normalizationDesc_comp also gives a;q=g.fromNormalization. This is the universal-property assembly, proved in Lean without a new hole.

The etale phi is smooth. Mathlib Hom.normalizationPullback phi is therefore an isomorphism between the normalization of the generic-cover pullback and the pullback of p.fromNormalization. Compose its inverse with the helper isomorphism to obtain alpha. Cancel the normalizationPullback isomorphism and use normalizationPullback_snd to prove the required equation over Spec R. Package the unchanged chart conclusion. The supplied finiteness hypothesis on p.fromNormalization is not needed for this route, but its binder stays unchanged.

lean.statement: theorem GaloisCover.trait_generic_normalization_chart (A K : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] {L : Scheme.{u}} (d : L ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) [QuasiCompact d] [QuasiSeparated d] [Smooth d] (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : A)) (W : GaloisCover G (pullback d (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A K))))) : letI : IsFinite W.π := W.isFinite let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A K)) let p := W.π ≫ pullback.fst d b IsFinite p.fromNormalization → ∀ x : L, ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (y : Spec R), Etale φ ∧ φ y = x ∧ ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : R) (e : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ k, 0 < e k ∧ IsUnit (e k : R)) ∧ ∃ α : pullback p.fromNormalization φ ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m, AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ e k - Polynomial.C f))), α.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (∀ k : Fin m, AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ e k - Polynomial.C f)))) = pullback.snd p.fromNormalization φ
